Payment plans

Motionby @praveenisomer2026-08-27inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Payment-plan card with a physical toggle metaphor: two little hanging tags (blue Monthly / orange Yearly) dangle above the card; flipping the plan swings the active tag, swings the card's neon edge-glow between blue and orange, rolls the price ($20.00 <-> $200.00), and swaps the feature list.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Dark card, Monthly active: blue glow rim + blue tag pulled down; '$20.00 Billed Monthly'; 4-item Includes list; 'Best For Those Who Want To Try It Out' ribbon below.
15-35%
Toggle: tags swing like pull-cords (pendulum rotate), glow crossfades blue->orange, price rolls odometer-style to $200.00, list crossfades to 6 items.
35-55%
Yearly settled: orange neon rim, 'Best For Long-Term Seeking Extra Benefits' ribbon; tag pendulum decays to rest.
55-85%
Flip back to Monthly: same swing + glow crossfade + price roll; ribbon text swaps.
85-100%
Loop; one frame reveals the component inside a Framer-like editor (it is a coded component).

Mechanics

trigger
plan toggle tap

loop

Build prompt

Build a payment-plan card with a pull-cord toggle. Card: dark (#0A0A0B), 16px radius, with a 1px rim and big soft outer glow in the plan color (blue #3B82F6 / orange #F59E0B) - glow = box-shadow 0 0 80px in the accent at 50%. Above the card, two small hanging tags (Monthly/Yearly) on 'strings'; the active plan's tag hangs lower and glows. Toggle: tags swing on transform-origin top with damped pendulum physics (angle +18deg -> 0, ~900ms, damping 0.12); rim glow crossfades color over 400ms; price rolls odometer digit columns ($20.00 <-> $200.00, 500ms); feature list crossfades item count (4 vs 6, staggered 40ms rows); ribbon under the card swaps its caption with a slide-up. Toggle control: segmented Monthly|Yearly pill top-left with a sliding thumb.
